title: The Character for “Chinese Scholar Tree”
synopsis: There are many legends about demon spirits in the Chinese scholar tree.

fullText.simplified:
关于“槐”字

    今天给大家讲一个有趣的汉字——“槐”。“槐”，读作“huái”，左边一个“木”字，右边一个“鬼”字。“槐”是一种树，中国人常常叫它“槐树”。那么，为什么“槐”字里边有个“鬼”字呢？
    先来看看“鬼”这个字。“鬼”的甲骨文上半部分是一个戴着面具的人头，下半部分是人的身体。古人是这么理解“鬼”的：首先，古人认为“鬼”很丑陋；其次，古人认为“鬼”很高大。
    “槐”之所以有个“鬼”字是因为“槐”具有了“鬼”所有的特点：首先，槐树的上边常常长一种叫“瘿瘤”的东西，这个东西看起来像一个个的疙瘩，特别丑陋；其次，槐树很高大。
    可能也是因为“槐”里有个“鬼”字，中国老百姓自古就认为“槐树”是“木中之鬼”，会招来不干净的东西。所以动物死后不能埋在槐树下，房前屋后不能种槐树，就连休息也最好不要坐在槐树下，因为如果在槐树下睡着了会做一些奇怪的梦。
    当然，随着经济的发展和人们知识水平的提高，上边提到的一些迷信想法慢慢减弱了。槐树不仅不“坏”，优点还很多呢。五月，槐树花一开，一整条街都能闻到甜甜的槐花香，让人觉得心旷神怡。高大的槐树也会被人们种在院子里，槐树底下就成了夏天乘凉最好的场所。
fullText.traditional:
關於“槐”字

    今天給大家講一個有趣的漢字——“槐”。“槐”，讀作“huái”，左邊一個“木”字，右邊一個“鬼”字。“槐”是一種樹，中國人常常叫它“槐樹”。那麼，為什麼“槐”字裡邊有個“鬼”字呢？
    先來看看“鬼”這個字。“鬼”的甲骨文上半部分是一個戴著面具的人頭，下半部分是人的身體。古人是這麼理解“鬼”的：首先，古人認為“鬼”很醜陋；其次，古人認為“鬼”很高大。
    “槐”之所以有個“鬼”字是因為“槐”具有了“鬼”所有的特點：首先，槐樹的上邊常常長一種叫“癭瘤”的東西，這個東西看起來像一個個的疙瘩，特別醜陋；其次，槐樹很高大。
    可能也是因為“槐”裡有個“鬼”字，中國老百姓自古就認為“槐樹”是“木中之鬼”，會招來不乾淨的東西。所以動物死後不能埋在槐樹下，房前屋後不能種槐樹，就連休息也最好不要坐在槐樹下，因為如果在槐樹下睡著了會做一些奇怪的夢。
    當然，隨著經濟的發展和人們知識水平的提高，上邊提到的一些迷信想法慢慢減弱了。槐樹不僅不“壞”，優點還很多呢。五月，槐樹花一開，一整條街都能聞到甜甜的槐花香，讓人覺得心曠神怡。高大的槐樹也會被人們種在院子裡，槐樹底下就成了夏天乘涼最好的場所。

sentence_translations: The Character for “Chinese Scholar Tree”
Today let’s talk about an interesting Chinese character⁠—“Chinese scholar tree”.
It is pronounced “huai”, with the character for “tree” on the left and the character for “ghost” on the right.
“Chinese scholar tree” is a kind of tree, and Chinese people often call it “huai shu”.
So, why does “Chinese scholar tree” contain the character “ghost”?
Let’s first look at the character “ghost”.
Looking at oracle bone inscriptions for “ghost”, the upper part is a human head wearing a mask, and the lower part is a human body.
Ancient people understood “ghosts” like this: First of all, ancient people believed ghosts were very ugly.
Second, ancient people believed ghosts were very tall.
The reason why “Chinese scholar tree” contains the character “ghost” is that it has all the characteristics of a ghost.
First, things called burls often grow on the surface of Chinese scholar trees.
These things look like a series of lumps and are very ugly.
Second, Chinese scholar trees are very tall.
Perhaps due to the fact that the character “Chinese scholar tree” contains the character “ghost”, ..
.. ordinary people have believed since ancient times that the “Chinese scholar tree” is “the ghost of trees”, ..
.. and will attract unclean things.
Therefore, animals shouldn’t be buried under Chinese scholar trees after they die, ..
.. and Chinese scholar trees cannot be planted in front of or behind a house.
Moreover, it is best not to even sit down for a rest under a Chinese scholar tree, ..
.. because you will have strange dreams if you fall asleep under a Chinese scholar tree.
Of course, with the economic development and the improvement of people’s knowledge, ..
.. the superstitious ideas mentioned above have gradually fallen off.
Chinese scholar trees are not just not “bad”, they even have many merits
In May, when the Chinese scholar trees blossom, ..
.. their sweet fragrance fills the whole street and makes people feel carefree and relaxed.
People also plant tall Chinese scholar trees in their yards.
The best place to cool down in summer is beneath a Chinese scholar tree.
